The 90-day governance blueprint and the entropy principle

takeaways: Copilot does not create governance problems; it exposes oversharing, permission sprawl and unlabeled data that accumulated because governance was omitted at the start.
Governance must follow an immutable sequence of identity, classification, enforcement and audit, because DLP has nothing to match against when 90% of files are unlabeled.
A 90-day governance-first blueprint costs far less than a reactive remediation project that can take nine months or more after a Copilot rollout stalls.
hook: Most Microsoft 365 deployments chase adoption first and plan to add governance later, until a Copilot pilot exposes years of oversharing and sprawl. This episode helps IT and security leaders understand why governance timing decides success and how a 90-day identity, classification and enforcement blueprint avoids costly remediation.
